sections.heading: About the team
sections.content: Robomart is an extremely ambitious startup with the vision of giving consumers anything they need - instantaneously. Marketing team members are the champions of our business, and are responsible for ensuring that this promise gets delivered.

sections.heading: About the role
sections.content: You’ll have an opportunity to be a part of a team that is revolutionizing retail by creating a new way to shop and work at the ground level for a game changing service in its early stages.

sections.heading: Responsibilities
sections.content:
Manage our social media channels
Work collaboratively with our analytics team members to derive insights
Engage with senior management to define marketing KPIs
Discover novel ways to onboard users

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.content:
Experience managing social media accounts
Basic understanding of marketing principles
Ambitious, relentless attitude to learn

sections.heading: Preferred
sections.content:
Degree in marketing or communications from a top college
Experience interning at a high growth startup
Extreme passion for delivery, logistics and retail

sections.heading: Benefits
sections.content:
Joining an exciting venture-backed startup at the ground level
Flexible hours
Ability to transition to a full time role
Stock options (once transitioned into full time role)

sections.heading: About Us
sections.content: Based in Santa Monica, Calif., Robomart, Inc. has created the world’s first mobile supermarket through its fleet of on-demand, automated stores. Robomarts are engineered with cutting-edge technology, giving consumers the fastest possible way to get their groceries. Founded in 2017 by serial entrepreneurs with deep domain expertise in delivery, robotics, and retail, the company is venture backed and on a mission is to create the most convenient way to shop. To learn more about Robomart, visit robomart.co.

sections.heading: How to Apply
sections.content:
Does this role sound like a good fit? Email us at talent@robomart.co or fill out the application below.
Include the role's title in your subject line.
Send along links that best showcase the relevant things you've built and done.

Robomart is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Robomart does not make hiring or employment decisions of people and other sentient beings on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Robomart also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.
